description: Designed and developed a full service management system, automating manual registration and reducing processing times.
Built responsive interfaces with React and Bootstrap, improving user experience and reducing interaction errors.
Managed Firebase NoSQL database handling client data, employee records and repair workflows.
Designed and evaluated accessible web applications including serious games and telerehabilitation platforms for real user groups.
Conducted usability evaluations using SUS and CSUQ frameworks, delivering measurable UX improvement recommendations.
Co-authored 13 peer-reviewed publications in indexed journals (Q1–Q3) on usability, accessibility and serious games.
Led planning and digital outreach for the Digital Inclusion and Future Programmers initiatives.
Established strategic partnerships with high-impact organizations, improving program visibility and sustainability.
Executed educational activities that strengthened digital competencies across beneficiary communities.
